i#1686 decoder tests: OP_mov and OP_lsl do not touch flags

Fixes a bug from 4d8bc7cf2f799ffe0434f9fa59186efe988b5400: OP_mov and
OP_lsl do not touch the condition flags.

Also fixes a release-build compiler warning with recent gcc versions.

Review-URL: https://codereview.appspot.com/229330043

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the incorrect representation of the `OP_mov` and `OP_lsl` instructions in the instruction table, where they were incorrectly marked as affecting the condition flags (fWNZCV) instead of indicating that they do not touch the flags (x). This misrepresentation could lead to incorrect behavior in the disassembly and execution of these instructions.
